name: io.github.bimwright/ipt-mcp
description: MCP gateway for Autodesk Inventor 2022-2027: parts, assemblies, drawings and automation.

environmentVariables.name: BIMWRIGHT_INVENTOR_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1/true to expose only tools annotated read-only; no document/file writes or send_code.

environmentVariables.name: BIMWRIGHT_INVENTOR_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable (meta,query,document,parameters,properties,sketch,feature,export,assembly,assembly_query,drawing,drawing_query,code,toolbaker,toolbaker_write); 'all' enables every known toolset.

environmentVariables.name: BIMWRIGHT_INVENTOR_ENABLE_SEND_CODE
environmentVariables.description: Code tools are enabled by default. Set to 0/false to hide them. The add-in kill switch BIMWRIGHT_INVENTOR_PLUGIN_DISABLE_SEND_CODE=1 rejects execution.

environmentVariables.name: BIMWRIGHT_INVENTOR_TARGET
environmentVariables.description: Pin the active target by 4-digit Inventor year (e.g. 2025) or descriptor id.

environmentVariables.name: BIMWRIGHT_INVENTOR_CALL_LOG_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1/true to record redacted calls on the server and plug-in. Default false.
